provenance.label: Lists ranked by reviews; the original project lists where reviews are too few
provenance.ranking: On 37 systems, games are ranked by critic reviews of that system's version (the review boxes on English Wikipedia: magazines such as EGM, Famitsu, GamePro and Mean Machines, and sites such as IGN) and IGDB player ratings, combined by how much evidence each has. A list keeps up to 100 games with enough reviews and an above-average score; later ports count only their own reviews. The other systems keep the original editorial order, after removing duplicate and unverified alternate entries. Ranks apply within each system or collection, not across the entire library.
provenance.verification: Review-backed lists are rebuilt from public data by npm run retro:lists; each game links to its sources. The original lists keep their order, which can't be traced to sources, but their facts were checked: 311 entries that aren't a released game on that system were taken out and 257 titles corrected (data/legacy-corrections.json), and release years follow IGDB where it confirms the game on that system.
